title: Lighthouse · source-paired native drawing

source.why_this_clip: A red and white striped lighthouse seen from below against the sky, with its lantern at the top, while the camera tilts up and the tower shifts across the frame. The clip is one continuous tilt with no detected cuts; this interval is the part where the whole top of the tower and the lantern are in frame.

camera.source: shots/lighthouse-sam/camera.json: phase correlation of the footage with the lighthouse masked out; the camera tilts up, so trees and sky slide down the frame by about 137 px over the shot

planes.label: Clouds in the sky. Depth Anything reads the sky as far, but the camera only tilts, and in a tilt near and far things move the same on screen; the measured background shift equals the tower's own shift, so this plane moves with the camera at the tower's rate.
Trees at the edges of the frame, seen from below. Same rate as the tower, for the same reason.
